title: Hospitality Oriented Service Perception Evolution With Robots (HOSPER)
official: Hospitality Oriented Service Perception Evolution With Robots (HOSPER)
summary: The HOSPER project aims to determine if using Pepper and NAO social robots at the IRCCS INRCA in Ancona's (Italy) entrance is a viable way to improve the current reception and guidance services for hospital visitors. The robots will offer proactive assistance and directions to departments.

interventions.name: Innovative hospital reception service with social robot NAO
Innovative hospital reception service with social robot PEPPER
